label.text:
The animation editor shows a character and lets you fix where each animation is drawn.

Pick a character on the left, then pick an animation. The Offset tab on the right has the X and Y of that animation. You can also drag the character with the left mouse button, or use the arrow keys (the step is set in the Offset tab). Pan with the middle mouse button or two fingers and zoom with the wheel or a pinch.

The Playback tab pauses the animation and steps it frame by frame, and changes its frame rate and loop. The Character tab edits the scale, flip, pixel art, dance and sing times and the starting animation. The View tab has the onion skin (a faint idle pose behind the character), the grid, the origin, the frame bounds and the camera focus point.

Edit has tools that work on every animation: copy one offset to all of them, copy it to the opposite direction (left to right), mirror or shift them all. Everything can be undone.

Save Character JSON writes the character data with your changes. Save to Mods Folder writes it into the first enabled mod as gameplay/characters/id.json, keeping a backup of the old file, so the game uses it. Check the Animations lists animations that look wrong, like a missing idle or a sing animation without a miss version.
